events.zh: 大罷免第二波：7 案全數未通過
events.en: Mass recall wave 2: all 7 fail

events.en: FY2025 supplementary budget NT$81.9B passed

events.zh: 115 年度總預算案送達立法院（另有 8/29 一說）
events.en: FY2026 budget delivered to the LY (some sources say Aug 29)

events.zh: 院會邀行政院長、主計長、財政部長列席報告總預算案編製經過
events.en: Premier, DGBAS and MOF report to the LY plenary on the budget

events.zh: 預算法第 51 條期限（會計年度開始一個月前）屆滿，總預算案仍未付委
events.en: Statutory deadline (one month before the fiscal year) passes; the bill is still not in committee

events.zh: 行政院長卓榮泰依憲法第 37 條「不副署」立法院三讀的財劃法修正案（憲政首例）；理由含 115 年度須增加舉債 2,646 億、舉債占歲出比恐達 17.1%（逾公債法 15% 上限）
events.en: Premier Cho Jung-tai declines to countersign the amended Fiscal Allocation Act under Constitution Art. 37, a first in ROC history; grounds include NT$264.6B more borrowing for FY2026 and a borrowing ratio of 17.1% (above the 15% statutory cap)

events.zh: 跨年前仍卡關：在野以未依法編列軍人待遇、警察人事條例預算為由；行政院稱有違憲疑慮已聲請釋憲
events.en: Still stalled before New Year: opposition cites missing pay-raise budgets; EY says the laws are being challenged as unconstitutional

events.zh: 總預算案交付委員會審查（另有 4/21 一說）
events.en: Budget referred to committees (some say Apr 21)

events.zh: 教育及文化委員會審文化部：媒宣費 4,738 萬成焦點，召委裁示凍 800 萬
events.en: Education & Culture Committee reviews MOC: NT$47.38M publicity in focus, NT$8M frozen

events.zh: 視覺藝術聯盟聲明：「晶片可以讓台灣被需要，文化才能讓台灣被理解」
events.en: Visual Arts Alliance statement: "Chips make Taiwan needed; culture makes Taiwan understood"

events.zh: 115 年度總預算三讀：減列 480 億（1.58%）；史上最晚三讀
events.en: FY2026 budget passed: NT$48B cut (1.58%); latest passage on record

events.zh: 行政院晚間列「7 項非理性決議」；文化部長李遠：「損失的是台灣在世界的話語權」
events.en: EY lists "seven unreasonable resolutions"; Culture Minister Lee: "what is lost is Taiwan's voice in the world"

events.zh: 國民黨張雅屏反駁「351 天」：送案到付委卡 235 天，付委後實審 115 天
events.en: KMT's Chang Ya-ping rebuts "351 days": 235 days stuck before committee, 115 days of actual review

events.zh: 行政院會通過 116 年度總預算案：歲入歲出各 3 兆 9,266 億，較 115 年度預算案增 29.4%；含普發現金 2,357 億、國防整體 1 兆 1,225 億
events.en: Cabinet approves the FY2027 bill: NT$3.9266T revenue and expenditure, +29.4% on the FY2026 proposal; includes NT$235.7B universal cash payout, NT$1.1225T defense (NATO basis)

events.zh: 行政院提出 115 年度追加預算案：歲出 6,076 億、歲入 828 億；追加後 115 年度歲出 3 兆 5,946 億、歲入 3 兆 5,471 億
events.en: Executive Yuan proposes a FY2026 supplementary budget: NT$607.6B expenditure, NT$82.8B revenue; FY2026 would reach NT$3.5946T spending

events.zh: 立法院院會：116 年度總預算案與 115 年度追加預算案一讀，交付委員會審查
events.en: Legislative Yuan floor: FY2027 bill and the FY2026 supplementary bill pass first reading and go to committees

events.zh: 朝野協商：10 月 23 日邀行政院長報告追加預算、10 月 27 日報告 116 年度總預算
events.en: Cross-caucus deal: Premier to brief on the supplementary budget on 23 Oct and the FY2027 bill on 27 Oct

days.zh: 「總預算拖了 266 天終於審查完畢」
days.en: "after 266 days the review is finally done"

days.zh: 「付委後實質審查只有 115 天」
days.en: "only 115 days of substantive review after committee referral"

items.zh: 「損失的是台灣在世界的話語權，以及詮釋台灣主權觀點的管道。」——文化部長李遠，2026-08-14
items.en: "What is lost is Taiwan's voice in the world and a channel to explain Taiwan's view of its own sovereignty." — Culture Minister Lee Yuan, 2026-08-14

items.zh: 行政院發言人李慧芝列出 7 項「非理性決議」：NCC 8–12 月基本行政經費全刪、政策宣導費刪近五成、國務機要費刪凍等——2026-08-14
items.en: EY spokesperson Li Hui-chih lists seven "unreasonable resolutions": NCC's Aug–Dec operating funds fully cut, publicity budgets nearly halved, presidential state-affairs fund cut/frozen — 2026-08-14

items.zh: 「多項不合理的刪除及凍結理由，展現出對文化部所有努力的否定，以及對文化工作者的不尊重。」——文化部新聞稿，回應 114 年度三讀
items.en: "Many unreasonable cut and freeze rationales negate everything the ministry has done and disrespect cultural workers." — MOC statement on the FY2025 budget

opp.zh: 在野黨（國民黨／民眾黨）的說法

items.zh: 「回顧 97 至 114 年度，中央總預算從送案到三讀需要 104 至 152 天，中位數約 139 天。115 年度付委後只審 115 天，不但沒有反常，還接近歷年較短的一端。」——國民黨考紀會主委張雅屏，2026-08-16
items.en: "From FY2008 to FY2025 the central budget took 104–152 days from submission to passage, median ~139. FY2026 got 115 days after referral — not abnormal, near the short end." — KMT's Chang Ya-ping, 2026-08-16

items.zh: 「480 億元除以行政院原列歲出 3 兆 350 億元，約為 1.58%；低於 102 年度的 1.90%。」——張雅屏，同上
items.en: "NT$48B over the proposed NT$3.035T is about 1.58%, below FY2013's 1.90%." — Chang Ya-ping, ibid.

items.zh: 在野黨團 2025 年 12 月的付委條件：行政院須依法編列軍人待遇條例、警察人員人事條例相關預算——中央社 2025-12-27
items.en: Opposition caucuses' condition for referral in Dec 2025: the EY must budget for the military pay and police personnel acts as passed — CNA 2025-12-27

items.zh: 「換掉一個卓榮泰，還有千千萬萬個卓榮泰，然後宣布解散國會」——國民黨立法院黨團書記長羅智強，2025-12-15
items.en: "Replace one Cho Jung-tai and there'll be thousands more, then dissolve the legislature." — KMT caucus secretary-general Lo Chih-chiang, 2025-12-15

items.zh: 「副署制度絕不能作為行政院否決立法院三讀通過法律的權力依據，這是扭曲憲法規範的權力濫用」——民眾黨立法院黨團總召黃國昌，2025-12-15
items.en: "The countersignature can never be a basis for the Executive Yuan to veto a law the legislature has passed; this is an abuse of power that distorts the Constitution." — TPP caucus leader Huang Kuo-chang, 2025-12-15

items.zh: 「晶片可以讓台灣被需要，文化才能讓台灣被理解。」「監督政府不能以消滅台灣的發聲能力為代價。」——視覺藝術聯盟，2026-07-21
items.en: "Chips make Taiwan needed; culture makes Taiwan understood." "Oversight must not come at the cost of Taiwan's ability to speak." — Visual Arts Alliance, 2026-07-21

items.zh: 「拖了 266 天⋯⋯拜託朝野都能各退一步，在野黨展現成熟監督的國會高度，行政院展現尊重法治的憲政風範。」——立法院長韓國瑜，2026-08-14
items.en: "266 days... I plead with both sides to step back — the opposition to show mature oversight, the Executive Yuan to show respect for the rule of law." — Speaker Han Kuo-yu, 2026-08-14
